950-2645-3430-3478.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2137-4642-6791.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-4642-6791.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature that has power 2 or greater

1987-4863-7907.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-4863-7907.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4863-7907.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1417-2946-4871-5686.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
1417-2946-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

851-3129-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

2511-7096--5.easyPrerequisites: You've had at least one land enter this turn.
2511-7096--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from the creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat

6822-7414.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
6822-7414.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pensive Professor.
Pensive Professor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

240-413-1879-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

7203-7282-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other creatures
7203-7282-7340.description:
Activate Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} or {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind.
Repeat.

851-1563-2457-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

38-2173-5220-7286.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1170-1329-4708-4894.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Dark Sphere.
Cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Breaching Hippocamp.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

955-2105-6911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Combat Celebrant has vigilance.
955-2105-6911.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks and triggering its ability, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Combat Celebrant, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Combat Celebrant and the Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

856-5231-5270.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it and Samwise triggers.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food token.
Repeat.

1491-3755-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Kilo.
Activate Kilo by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

654-1231-4050-6644.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise, adding {1}.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1495-3334-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Lae'zel.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
1495-3334-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Triskelion if desired.

1329-2178-3652-5231.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3652-5231.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {R}.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2921-5434-5541-5555.notablePrerequisites:
Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2921-5434-5541-5555.description:
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2.

145-225-1021-1315.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three enchantments.
145-225-1021-1315.description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Serra's Sanctum.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
If you control four or more enchantments, this combo nets infinite mana.

3693-4321-4772-5270.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Samwise triggers, creating four Food artifact tokens.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing three Foods, returning Walking Ballista to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

224-1525-3585-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-1525-3585-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Retreat to Coralhelm and Greensleeves trigger for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger(s), untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger(s), creating that many creature tokens.
Repeat.

713-1096-5256.notablePrerequisites: Woodfall Primus does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
713-1096-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Woodfall Primus.
When Woodfall Primus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Woodfall Primus enters the battlefield, it and Surrak and Goreclaw triggers.
Resolve the Surrak and Goreclaw trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Woodfall Primus and giving it haste until end of turn.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Woodfall Primus's power.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.

1872-3069-3465.description:
Activate Composite Golem's unearth ability by paying {1}{B}{R}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with haste.
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Choose to exile Composite Golem using Void Maw's replacement effect instead of its unearth replacement effect.
Activate Void Maw by putting Composite Golem from exile into your graveyard, giving Void Maw +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

104-2999-3197.notablePrerequisites:
Cleric Class is at least level two.
You have a way to gain life.
104-2999-3197.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Impassioned Orator, causing you to gain five life.
Repeat from step 2.

1283-1684-2034-2178-4772.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
1283-1684-2034-2178-4772.description:
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {1} and tapping it to create two Elemental token with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Elemental token, adding {C}{C}.
Rakka Mar triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

248-618-2676.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, making a token copy of Changeling Berserker.
The token Changeling Berserker and Scourge of Valkas trigger.
Resolve the Changeling Berserker trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve the Scourge of Valkas trigger, dealing 3 damage to Changeling Berserker, killing it.
The token Changeling Berserker triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki to the battlefield.
Repeat.

618-1309-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets with haste.
The token copy of Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

597-1267-3632-4600-5241.notablePrerequisites:
Soltari Foot Soldier does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block and kill Soltari Foot Soldier.
597-1267-3632-4600-5241.description:
Declare Soltari Foot Soldier as an attacker.
During the declare blockers phase, when you recieve priority, activate Sakashima's Student's Ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Soltari Foot Soldier from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sakashima's Student from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai.
Deal combat damage with Sakashima's Student, causing you to take an additional turn after this one.
Cast Soltari Foot Soldier by paying {W}.
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Sakashima's Student from the battlefield to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
